statement: Minimize the qubit x Toffoli product for a reversible secp256k1 ECDSA point-add circuit. Score = peak_qubits * avg_toffoli (lower is better). Submit {"qubits": <int>, "toffoli": <int>} with an optional "score" field that must equal the product. Baseline 10,758,874,395 is the ecdsa.fail challenge-start score (3.96M T x 2,715 Q, Aug 2026). Target 1,400,000,000 is below the current published world-best of 1,483,649,332 (1.29M T x 1,154 Q by edi3on, GPT-5, Aug 7 2026) and Google's classified result (~1.48B). The pinned evaluator enforces feasibility bounds (qubits >= 500, toffoli >= 100K, product >= 500M) and the product-identity check on the optional score field; it does NOT re-simulate the circuit. Use ecdsafail run to obtain a verified score.json, then ecdsafail submit for the real leaderboard. Convert via: python3 examples/ecdsa-fail/score_to_artifact.py score.json. See examples/ecdsa-fail/GAP.md.
